name: 198. Live admission needs one allowed key that serves both models (OpenAI local fixture)
description: A live session runs its voice model and its backend model on one upstream connection, so one provider key has to serve both. Governance can limit a virtual key to a subset of the provider's keys; admission has to narrow key selection to that subset before looking for a key that serves both models (PR #8293). The case builds a run-scoped provider with a voice-only key, a backend-only key and an every-model key, limits the virtual key to the two split keys, and creates a WebRTC session naming both models on POST /v1/live/sessions, which runs the same admission as the WebSocket session.start. Red before the fix: the every-model key was still eligible, the create went upstream and failed on the fixture's SDP answer (502). Green after: 400 'no keys found ... that support both model' and nothing reaches the provider, so the local fixture does not need to be running.

item.name: [EXPECT-400] openai/gpt-live-1 WebRTC create refused when no allowed key serves both models - live key admission

exec: var provider = 'openai-live-keys-' + Date.now() + '-' + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1e6);
pm.variables.set('liveKeysProvider', provider);
var base = pm.variables.get('baseUrl');
var headers = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-Bifrost-Setup-Token': pm.variables.get('setupToken') || 'bifrost-e2e-setup-token' };
function post(url, body, label, next) {
pm.sendRequest({url: base + url, method: 'POST', header: headers, body: {mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify(body)}}, function (err, res) {
pm.test(label, function () { pm.expect(err).not.to.be.ok; pm.expect(res && res.code, res && res.text()).to.be.below(300); });
if (err || res.code >= 300) throw new Error('cannot: ' + label);
next(res);
// Three keys: one per model and one for every model. The virtual key may use only the two split keys.

post('/api/providers', {provider: provider, custom_provider_config: {base_provider_type: 'openai'}, network_config: {base_url: pm.variables.get('providerErrorFixtureUrl'), max_retries: 0, default_request_timeout_in_seconds: 10}}, 'Run-scoped fake provider created', function () {
post('/api/providers/' + provider + '/keys', {name: 'voice-only', value: 'sk-fake-voice-only', models: ['gpt-live-1'], weight: 1}, 'Voice-only key created', function () {
post('/api/providers/' + provider + '/keys', {name: 'backend-only', value: 'sk-fake-backend-only', models: ['gpt-5.6-luna'], weight: 1}, 'Backend-only key created', function () {
post('/api/providers/' + provider + '/keys', {name: 'every-model', value: 'sk-fake-every-model', models: ['*'], weight: 1}, 'Every-model key created', function () {
pm.sendRequest({url: base + '/api/providers/' + provider + '/keys', method: 'GET', header: headers}, function (err, res) {
pm.test('Provider keys listed', function () { pm.expect(err).not.to.be.ok; pm.expect(res && res.code, res && res.text()).to.equal(200); });
if (err || res.code !== 200) throw new Error('cannot list provider keys');
var ids = {}; (res.json().keys || []).forEach(function (k) { ids[k.name] = k.id; });
pm.test('Split keys have ids', function () { pm.expect(ids['voice-only'], res.text()).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(ids['backend-only'], res.text()).to.be.a('string'); });

post('/api/governance/virtual-keys', {name: provider, provider_configs: [{provider: provider, weight: 1, allowed_models: ['gpt-live-1', 'gpt-5.6-luna'], key_ids: [ids['voice-only'], ids['backend-only']]}]}, 'Virtual key created', function (vkRes) {
pm.variables.set('liveKeysVK', vkRes.json().virtual_key.value);
pm.variables.set('liveKeysVKID', vkRes.json().virtual_key.id);
var provider = pm.variables.get('liveKeysProvider');
var base = pm.variables.get('baseUrl');
// Admission narrows key selection to the virtual key's keys first: neither split key serves both
// models, and the every-model key is off limits, so the create is refused before anything reaches
// the provider. Before the fix the every-model key was picked and the create went upstream.
pm.test('No allowed key serves both models: the create is refused with 400', function () {
pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.equal(400);
var err = pm.response.json().error || {};
pm.expect(err.type, pm.response.text()).to.equal('invalid_request_error');
pm.expect(err.message, pm.response.text()).to.include('support both model');
pm.sendRequest({url: base + '/api/governance/virtual-keys/' + pm.variables.get('liveKeysVKID'), method: 'DELETE'}, function (vkErr, vkRes) {
pm.test('Virtual key removed', function () { pm.expect(vkErr).not.to.be.ok; pm.expect(vkRes && vkRes.code, vkRes && vkRes.text()).to.equal(200); });
pm.sendRequest({url: base + '/api/providers/' + provider, method: 'DELETE'}, function (err, res) {
pm.test('Run-scoped provider removed', function () { pm.expect(err).not.to.be.ok; pm.expect(res && res.code, res && res.text()).to.equal(200); });
